pe_assessment: Snapshot trailing/forward P/E 23.10/6.30; forward earnings may be near a cycle peak. Derived adjusted FY FCF yield is 3.60%, more restrained than the earnings multiple.
margin_analysis: Q4 revenue $8.97bn (+51% sequentially); adjusted operating income $7.104bn. GAAP profit includes $804m equity gains; adjusted net income $6.162bn is the better earnings reference.
debt_analysis: Cash $4.762bn; current and long-term debt zero. FY adjusted FCF $8.743bn deducts Flash Ventures and NBM prepayments from reported $11.494bn FCF.
growth_outlook: FY revenue rose 175%; Q1 FY27 revenue guidance $10.3–10.8bn is prospective. Pricing supplied two-thirds of Q4 sequential growth.
key_risks: Customer deposits and supply commitments constrain cash
summary: Normalized cash generation and a debt-free balance sheet support buy despite a powerful pricing cycle. Confidence is medium because peak earnings cannot be capitalized as permanent.
